project: Incremental native Rust backend inside the ORIGINAL Minecraft JVM

versions.hook: Outgoing zlib compression through a Fabric mixin; opt in with -Drusted.enabled=true
rust_replacements: Outgoing zlib encoder: real Minecraft handler/mixin verified, 301 cases per mode and loopback TCP
versions.gameplay_compatibility: Original Java game retained. Demo movement, menus, inventory, break/pickup/place and save/reload after process restart checked; full regression not established
versions.multiplayer_compatibility: Original codec interoperability and ordered TCP payloads verified. Authenticated Minecraft multiplayer NOT tested
versions.mods: Fabric loads the Java adapter; arbitrary mods and other loaders untested
versions.windows: DLL cross-compiled and packaged, but NOT executed under Windows
versions.game_launch_scope: Original Linux client, official demo mode; no authenticated multiplayer
